title: 팔랩닷앱
style: Alternative R&B with dembow-locked bounce and clap-driven rap; verse rides sparse kick, claps, and breathy high-register ad-libs, pre-chorus lifts with stacked harmonies and filter sweeps, chorus hits in half-time with chantable bilingual hook lines. Vocal production is close-mic and airy with doubled hook words, quick delay throws, and playful call-and-response. Ear candy includes handclap fills, reversed vocal swells, and tiny glitch chops between phrases. Bright, glossy, and punchy mix with a playful club sheen., vocal, latin, breathy, alternative r&b, rap

이 리듬을 타

song pal dot a i
